Home Décor-Monkey (H-22.2CM)

Bring a touch of playful sophistication to your interiors with this stunning Monkey Decorative Bowl. Standing at 22.2 cm tall, this charming piece features a finely sculpted monkey holding up a wide, leaf-shaped dish above its head. Every curve, from the monkey’s expressive face to the texture of the banana-leaf bowl, is crafted with exquisite detail, creating a décor accent that’s both whimsical and luxurious. Finished in an opulent antique gold tone, the sculpture combines artistry and function—making it not just a display piece but also a practical holder. Use it as a fruit bowl, a centerpiece for your coffee table, a stylish catch-all for keys and trinkets, or even as a unique festive display. Whether placed in your living room, entryway, dining area, or office, this decorative monkey instantly adds warmth, character, and a hint of exotic charm to any setting.

Features

  • Unique Artistic Design: Monkey sculpture holding a leaf-shaped bowl, combining playfulness with elegance.
  • Generous Size: Height approx. 22.2 cm—perfect for center tables, shelves, or sideboards.
  • Premium Finish: Antique gold-tone finish adds a luxurious and timeless look.
  • Versatile Utility: Ideal as a fruit bowl, centerpiece, catch-all tray, or purely ornamental décor.
  • Detailed Craftsmanship: Intricate detailing on both the monkey and the leaf bowl for a realistic and refined appearance.
  • Durable Material: Made from high-quality polyresin (or resin blend) for strength and longevity.
  • Easy to Maintain: Simply wipe with a dry or slightly damp cloth to keep it looking new.
  • Gift-Ready: A memorable present for housewarmings, birthdays, Home Décor or décor lovers.
  • MOQ- 40Pc.
